description: This Java class 'EntityEcaUtil' provides utility methods for managing Entity Event-Condition-Action (ECA) rules in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles loading, caching, and retrieving ECA rules from configuration files and resources, supporting asynchronous loading and avoiding duplicate rules.

classes.name: EntityEcaUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing Entity ECA rules, including loading, caching, and retrieving rules based on entity and event.

methods.name: getEntityEcaCache
methods.description: Retrieves or loads the ECA rules cache for a given entity ECA reader name.

methods.name: getEntityEcaReaderName
methods.description: Gets the ECA reader name associated with a delegator name from the configuration.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads ECA rules from configuration resources and populates the cache.

methods.name: getEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Parses XML resources to extract ECA rules.

methods.name: createEcaLoaderCallable
methods.description: Creates a callable task to load ECA rules from a resource handler.

methods.name: getEntityEcaRules
methods.description: Retrieves ECA rules for a specific entity and event from the cache.
